name: train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce-more
description:
RQ6, more real training data: train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce with WikiGoldSK train (Slovak
Wikipedia) and SlavicNER's Czech cross-topic train part (BSNLP news) added to CNEC 2.0
and UNER Slovak-SNK, every real corpus repeated 3x, and 10,000 examples drawn from each
OpenPII 1M train split. Train sentences whose text a dev or test split also holds are
left out (drop_overlap; 2026-10-21: 65 CNEC, 8 UNER, 6 WikiGoldSK and 14 SlavicNER
sentences). 5,017 real examples x 3 + 20,000 = 35,051 examples; 6,600 steps of 16
(about 3.0 passes, as train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce). Everything else is train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce.
Also scored on the WikiGoldSK and SlavicNER dev splits; SlavicNER's shares the topics
of its train part. Trained on MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md).
